original_clause_locators.meaning: Actual completed closure; full-value equality, both-side disk sorting and failure on resource exhaustion; separate phase/oracle/fanout timing; immutable fixed-source cohort and complete registered population. These statements cannot be silently replaced by the observed shortcut.
Independent A incremental/B full at checkpoints; full facts and independent controls; distinct workload/time scopes and no unsupported tail claims.

cohort_common.required_population_for_these_registered: 150 original shards, 1500 samples, N=30 per group; no pooling, prefixes or replacements

known_defect.mechanism: A is fully spooled; only complete same-layout stored-table raw typed-cell equality through both EOFs lets the shortcut skip B scratch insertion and reuse A sorted values. B projection/count/canonical-byte checks remain. Fallback retains both spools. This is not sampling or hash-only equality.
known_defect.affected_contract: Skipping B insertion changes the simultaneously occupied scratch footprint and the original SQLITE_FULL error boundary. A alone can fit when A+B would fail. The added public equal_input_order_witness key also changes the original public table JSON field set.
known_defect.not_established: The compatibility defect alone does not prove a logical false-equality result in every historical row or invalidate recorded original engine/phase timing. No claim that every old table hit the shortcut, or that the repaired cohort would complete within the same deadline, follows.
known_defect.future_aggregate_limit: An aggregate passing its frozen validator cannot erase a known producer-contract defect that the validator did not detect.

historical_measurement_validity.retained: Original emitted engine phase counts/times, build/fanout events and full typed-cell equality observations remain attributable to their exact original source and executable, subject to complete raw/source/slot validation.
historical_measurement_validity.required_annotation: Oracle hit/fallback is an implementation characteristic of that historical cohort; raw scratch peaks and oracle/fanout whole-wall times measure that implementation only. Public extra-field output remains the historical schema.
historical_measurement_validity.not_transferred: No repaired-source throughput, scratch peak, SQLITE_FULL behavior, 5-hour completion or release claim; no recomputed counterfactual time or simple doubling of scratch.

P8_006_scoped_coverage.possible_after_real_completion: A truly complete independently accepted historical fixed cohort can support the explicitly historical no-op/body/API/config/batch/fanout curves, phase attribution, observed closure status and full logical equality portions. Original source-bound regression evidence and current repair controls are separate evidence components, with their applicability stated.
P8_006_scoped_coverage.still_missing_now: The full 150/1500 aggregate and all required exact-source receipts are not accepted by this review. Thus no P8-006 done decision or count change is authorized.
P8_006_scoped_coverage.cannot_be_claimed_even_if_old_aggregate_: Unqualified compliance of the old cohort with unchanged original dual-spool scratch/error/public-schema semantics, or complete performance certification of the repaired current source.
P8_006_scoped_coverage.decision_boundary: The task wording does not explicitly demand a new full cohort after every observer/API repair. A narrowly stated historical-coverage acceptance requires the task owner to record the deviation and separate current regression applicability; it must not masquerade as proof that the original fixed oracle resource contract passed. If the intended acceptance claim includes that exact repaired-resource execution, the affected claim remains blocked.

current_source_adoption_and_release.repair: Restores A+B dual spool/dual cursor and the original nine public table fields; test-only formatting follows the actual formatter output.
current_source_adoption_and_release.required_evidence: Actual current-source related Rust controls including A-fits/A+B-SQLITE_FULL and public-field regression, plus original source admission and current applicable CI. This review does not itself execute or grant those results.
current_source_adoption_and_release.boundary: These regression controls can establish current compatibility repair. They do not produce a repaired-source scale curve, prove representative speedup, or establish current full-matrix 5-hour feasibility. Engineering acceptance and release scope remain distinct from historical performance.

minimal_legal_convergence: Keep both original cohorts and every failure immutable; wait for real terminal aggregate and complete exact-source population before any historical coverage acceptance.
Accept or reject each measured proposition against raw scope: engine phases and logical completed parity separately from scratch/error/public-output compatibility and oracle-inclusive elapsed time.
Use current b8ab source-bound regression/CI only for the repair it actually exercises; document which product/observer changes prevent transfer of old timing or budget-success claims.

A new full fixed-source registered study is required if the desired claim is repaired-source full 150/1500 execution under the original dual-spool resource/deadline contract or repaired-source performance. Original build/run/replay same-commit rules and oracle-inclusive deadline/fanout scopes are the concrete reason; no small replay, static estimate, or relabeling can prove that claim.

Do not impose that new study as an invented universal gate merely to preserve historical incremental coverage; equally, do not mark the old resource contract satisfied by a later two-case fix. Any task closeout must explicitly choose and justify its actual scope using original acceptance and dependencies.
